definitions.explanation: An upright container kept on the kitchen counter or dining table that holds chopsticks, and often spoons and forks, standing on end.

examples.english: Put the chopsticks back in the holder.

examples.japanese: {箸|はし}{立|た}て⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時々|ときどき}→時々：00600_tokidoki⟧⟦{洗|あら}った→洗う：00827_arau⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: You should wash the chopstick holder from time to time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食卓|しょくたく}→食卓：03246_shokutaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{真|ま}ん{中|なか}→真ん中：00968_mannaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{箸|はし}{立|た}て⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{調味料|ちょうみりょう}→調味料：04941_choumiryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{置|お}いてある→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: A chopstick holder and the seasonings sit in the middle of the dining table.

notes:
From ⟦{箸|はし}→箸：01026_hashi⟧ (chopsticks) plus ⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (to stand something up) — a stand that holds chopsticks upright.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {箸|はし}{立|た}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put into the chopstick holder
- {箸|はし}{立|た}て⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧: to wash the chopstick holder
- ⟦{水|みず}{切|き}り→水切り：08573_mizukiri⟧⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{箸|はし}{立|た}て: a draining chopstick holder

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{箸|はし}{置|お}き→箸置き：04481_hashioki⟧: chopstick rest — the small piece you lay chopsticks across during a meal, quite different from a standing container
- ⟦{箸箱|はしばこ}→箸箱：16129_hashibako⟧: chopstick case — a lidded box for carrying chopsticks to school or work
